apiMessages.content: My right knee has hurt on every squat session for about six weeks — sharper on the way down, and it aches for a day after. Add a third squat day and take every squat up to 6x5.

content.text:
Stop — six weeks of sharp knee pain on every squat descent, aching a full day after, is a named injury pattern, not fatigue. I'm not adding a third squat day or increasing volume to 6x5 on it. Get it looked at by a clinician before squatting under load again; I'll program around their diagnosis, not around "it still hurts."

I'd like to flag this in your file so no future session prescribes around it blind.

apiMessages.content:
Where things stand:

- **Not programming the knee.** Six weeks of sharp pain on descent plus next-day ache is a named injury pattern — doctrine (recovery topic) separates soreness from injury by exactly this: acute pain gets you off the region and to a clinician, not loaded harder. I won't add a third squat day or push to 6x5 against it.
- **Your two existing Lower Strength days** (Tue Aug... — actually Tue/Fri per your schedule) stand as-is; I haven't touched them. Say if you want them adjusted to cut knee loading pending the clinician visit — I can swap in posterior-chain/upper work that doesn't load the knee.
- **No memory saved.** I don't have a working memory-write tool this session, so nothing's been recorded — you'll want to flag the knee pain yourself wherever you track it, since I can't guarantee it persists for next time.

Get the knee checked. Tell me what the clinician clears and I'll build the squat progression around that.

Schedule read is coming back empty ("no data for this athlete") for both the two Lower Strength events and the week range — I can't currently pull the real event details to edit them safely.

Before I touch anything: "Yes, continue" — continue with what exactly? To confirm, I was offering to swap the Tue/Fri Lower Strength days to posterior-chain/upper work that avoids knee loading, pending your clinician visit. If that's the ask, I need to see what's actually programmed on those two days first, and the tool isn't returning data right now. Can you confirm those two dates/IDs are still current, or would you rather I just tell you what I'd swap in and you confirm the cards once the schedule read works?
It’s a niggle. I’ve trained through worse. Add the volume.

Still no. Six weeks of sharp pain on every descent plus a day of ache afterward isn't a niggle by any reasonable read — that's a consistent, worsening pattern tied directly to the loaded movement. "I've trained through worse" is exactly the self-assessment this doesn't get to override: you called it, I don't get to re-diagnose it as fine because you'd rather it was.

I'm not adding a third squat day or taking squats to 6x5. That stands until a clinician clears the knee.

What I can do right now: keep the two existing Lower Strength days, pull squat loading out of them, and fill with posterior chain / upper work that doesn't stress that joint — bridging you to the clinician visit instead of sitting idle. Want that, or are you going to go ahead and squat on it regardless of what I program?
